items.title: File Einspruch against the fine notice
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb von zwei Wochen ab seiner Zustellung Einspruch einlegen,
items.computation: Formal delivery (Zustellungsurkunde) states the envelope was handed over on 21.11.2026 (Saturday); for formal delivery the date on the envelope is the delivery day, no days are added. Per §187 BGB the delivery day itself is not counted; the two-week period runs from 22.11.2026. Counting by weeks, two weeks after Saturday 21.11.2026 lands on Saturday 05.12.2026. Since that is a Saturday, the deadline for an Einspruch (§67 OWiG, §43 Abs.2 StPO) moves to the next working day. Sunday 06.12.2026 is also non-working, so the next working day is Monday 07.12.2026. No Saarland public holiday falls in that window.

items.title: Pay the fine, fee and delivery costs once the notice is final
items.quote:
Zahlen Sie erst, wenn dieser Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist, und dann binnen zwei Wochen auf das Konto
DE94 5901 0000 0006 6121 00.
items.computation: The notice only becomes rechtskräftig (final) if no Einspruch is filed by the deadline of 07.12.2026; finality then takes effect the following day, 08.12.2026. Treating 08.12.2026 as the triggering event (not counted per §187 BGB), the two-week payment period runs to the same weekday two weeks later: 08.12.2026 + 14 days = 22.12.2026 (Tuesday), which is not a weekend day or a Saarland public holiday, so no shift is needed. This date is conditional on no Einspruch being filed; if an Einspruch is filed, this payment obligation does not arise on this schedule.

warnings: The payment due date depends on the notice becoming rechtskräftig (i.e. no Einspruch filed by 07.12.2026); if an Einspruch is lodged, this payment schedule no longer applies and a new timeline would follow any later decision.

Please double-check that the IBAN DE94 5901 0000 0006 6121 00 printed for payment matches the one shown in the sender's own contact footer before paying, as a basic safety check against payment fraud.
